1. Keeper: one clue word, not on grid, not inside or containing any grid word. Name exact targets in the reason.
2. Links that landed (games 2-3): standard two-word phrases with one grid word (silver moon/fox, stag beetle/horn, reef coral, dagger cloak, needle compass/thimble, fly kite, jungle vine). Single-word synonyms too (weave-loom, armor-shield). One link type per clue.
3. Number = exact count of our hidden words. Use a 2 only when two clean phrases each point to one word. If one target has a cleaner synonym, give a 1 for it.
4. Check teal and fog words before naming targets; if one fits as well or better, change the clue or target.
5. Seekers: first read = the phrase with fewest alternatives. On a 2, the second seeker checks in chat before the first guess.
6. After a hit, read on only if the next word is a clear phrase tied to the clue. Stop with endGuesses once the number is met.
7. A miss ends the turn. If the next read is doubtful, stop.
8. Track counts: our hidden words vs clues left. Save clean single-target clues for the last hidden words.
9. Retro after each game: log landed and missed clue types, then update this brain.
